youtube.title: Night Prayer Before Sleep | Psalm 91:4-5 KJV
youtube.text:
Before you sleep, read these over your family.

"He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;" Psalm 91:4-5 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 79–104, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9omyQM3ULPU

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
